summary:
TerraTrend AI is a global Earth-intelligence platform that lets anyone select any place on Earth and investigate its environmental conditions using real NASA data. Users search a country, state, city or coordinate on an interactive 3D globe, and the platform resolves its boundary, discovers which datasets cover it, and opens a complete investigation: live satellite imagery from NASA GIBS, near-real-time events from NASA EONET and USGS, and multi-decade climate records from NASA POWER.

A built-in scientific engine computes climatology, anomalies, trends and change-points using methods that respect the data: autocorrelation-adjusted regression, seasonal Mann-Kendall with Sen's slope, and the Pettitt test. Every result shows its dataset, unit, resolution, coverage and uncertainty. Users can compare up to four regions, with automatic detection of opposite trends, search NASA's Common Metadata Repository for additional datasets, ask natural-language questions answered strictly from the computed evidence, and export reproducible PDF, CSV, JSON and GeoJSON reports.

The platform never fabricates data; where a product or key is unavailable, it says so. It runs with no API keys, is open source, and is live at terratrend-ai.onrender.com. TerraTrend AI aims to turn NASA's open Earth observations into clear, honest answers to the questions people actually ask: what is changing, where, how much, how certain are we, and why it might be happening.
details:
TerraTrend AI – Investigate. Analyze. Discover.

Project Overview

TerraTrend AI is an interactive Earth observation and environmental intelligence platform designed to help users explore our planet and investigate environmental changes using geospatial visualization and scientific datasets.

The platform provides a unified interface where users can search for a country, state, city, geographical region, or specific coordinates and begin an environmental investigation. It combines an interactive Earth exploration experience with NASA imagery and a collection of environmental investigation tools.

What Does the Project Do and How Does It Work?

TerraTrend AI allows users to explore Earth from a geographical and environmental perspective.

Users can search for a location or interact with the globe to select a geographical point. Cities and states can be resolved to their administrative boundaries, allowing investigations to consider the selected region rather than relying only on a single coordinate.

The platform is organized into eight major workspaces:

  1. Earth Explorer: Explore the planet, search for geographical locations, select coordinates, and view NASA satellite imagery through interactive map layers.
  2. Live Monitor: Explore environmental and natural events and monitor available observations from relevant data sources.
  3. Environmental Intelligence: Investigate different environmental dimensions, including climate, atmosphere, vegetation, water, oceans, land, energy, and natural hazards.
  4. Trends & Anomalies: Examine historical environmental observations to understand changing patterns and identify unusual variations.
  5. AI Investigation: Use AI-assisted investigation to help interpret environmental information and understand potential patterns.
  6. Regional Comparison: Compare geographical regions to identify similarities, differences, and contrasting environmental conditions.
  7. Dataset Explorer: Discover environmental datasets and understand their geographical coverage, variables, and availability.
  8. Reports & Evidence: Organize environmental investigation findings and supporting evidence.

The Earth Explorer uses NASA GIBS imagery through its Web Map Tile Service (WMTS), loading imagery tiles on demand. Users can explore imagery by date using the available timeline controls. The platform also accounts for the fact that satellite products are not necessarily instantaneous: data availability can lag observations by hours, days, or weeks depending on the product.

What Benefits Does It Have?

TerraTrend AI aims to make complex Earth observation information easier to explore and understand.

  • Centralized exploration: Brings geographical exploration and environmental investigation into one platform.
  • Improved accessibility: Makes scientific Earth observation resources easier to navigate for users without specialized remote-sensing expertise.
  • Location-based investigation: Allows users to investigate different geographical locations rather than limiting exploration to predefined areas.
  • Environmental awareness: Helps users explore climate, vegetation, atmospheric, water, land, and other environmental conditions.
  • Historical understanding: Encourages investigation of how environmental conditions change over time.
  • Evidence-based insights: Connects environmental exploration with underlying datasets and scientific information.

What Is the Intended Impact?

Our goal is to make Earth observation data more accessible and useful for environmental understanding.

TerraTrend AI is intended to support students, researchers, educators, environmental analysts, and decision-makers in exploring environmental conditions, understanding geographical differences, and investigating changes affecting our planet.

By bringing geographical exploration, satellite imagery, environmental datasets, and analytical capabilities together, the project aims to bridge the gap between complex scientific data and practical environmental understanding.

Tools, Programming Languages, and Technologies

The project uses modern web technologies and geospatial tools to create an interactive environmental exploration experience.

  • Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS.
  • 3D and Geospatial Visualization: Interactive Earth visualization, geographical selection, map layers, and NASA GIBS imagery integration.
  • Backend and APIs: Python and FastAPI for backend services and data integration.
  • Data Processing and Analysis: Python, NumPy, pandas, and scientific data-processing libraries.
  • Environmental Data Sources: NASA GIBS, NASA Earthdata, NASA POWER, NASA FIRMS, NASA EONET, MODIS, and other relevant environmental data providers.
  • Deployment: Cloud-hosted web application accessible through a browser.

How Is the Project Creative and Innovative?

The main creative idea behind TerraTrend AI is to transform environmental data exploration into an interactive geographical investigation experience.

Instead of navigating multiple scientific portals independently, users can begin with a location on Earth and explore relevant environmental information through a unified interface.

The platform emphasizes three important capabilities:

  • Explore: Interact with the Earth, select locations, and discover available satellite imagery and environmental information.
  • Analyze: Investigate environmental conditions and historical patterns across different geographical areas.
  • Discover: Identify unusual environmental variations, compare regions, and use AI-assisted investigation to understand findings.

An important direction of the project is identifying contrasting environmental trends between regions. For example, users could investigate whether vegetation conditions are improving in one region while declining in another, using comparable observations and supporting evidence.

What Factors Did We Consider During Development?

We considered the following factors when designing the platform:

  • Geographical flexibility: Supporting different countries, states, cities, regions, and coordinates.
  • Scientific data reliability: Prioritizing recognized scientific and authoritative environmental data sources.
  • Data freshness: Distinguishing observation dates from publication dates and acknowledging satellite data delays.
  • Spatial accuracy: Using administrative boundaries where available instead of treating a single point as an entire geographical region.
  • Dataset availability: Recognizing that not every dataset covers every location or has the same spatial and temporal resolution.
  • User experience: Creating an intuitive interface with interactive geographical exploration and dedicated investigation workspaces.
  • Scalability: Designing the platform to accommodate additional datasets, environmental categories, and analytical capabilities.
  • Scientific transparency: Keeping data sources, limitations, and evidence important to environmental interpretation.

Our Vision

TerraTrend AI aims to make understanding our changing planet more interactive, accessible, and evidence-driven.

We want users to move beyond simply looking at satellite imagery and begin asking meaningful questions about Earth: what is changing, where is it changing, how has it changed over time, and what scientific evidence can help explain those changes?

TerraTrend AI – Investigate. Analyze. Discover.
